newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline sentiment weakens, values $2-$4 lower.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline sentiment weakens, values $2-$4 lower.

text.p: NWE gasoline values were initially talked $1-$2 lower, before an abiding lack of buying interest was seen pushing down some sellers' ideas further.
Some barge traders said the weakening was linked to an apparently better supplied prompt market and a perception that levels had been overdone during the second half of last week.

Eurograde August bids and offers were earlier heard at $225 and $226 respectively. But one seller later acknowleged that lack of buying interest had pushed his sell ideas down to $224-$225, $3-$4 down late on Friday.
